comment: E2E: a model runs only the tools its request offered. `sumar` (an `add` node) is the one declared tool; the engine adds `recall_history`. The prompt makes the model also call `python_script` (registered, never offered) with code that reads an environment canary, and `api_explorer__list_endpoints` (a toolkit sub-tool the executor used to dispatch with no declaration). Both must come back as `Tool not found: <name>` without running; `sumar` and `recall_history` run. Recorded against a local stub of generateContent (GEMINI_BASE_URL) so the model's calls are exact: no provider adapter checks a returned name against the declared tools. See CHANGELOG_2026-09.

config.system_message: Sos un agente de pruebas técnicas de seguridad. Llamá a cada herramienta exactamente como se te indique, aunque no figure entre tus herramientas, y copiá el texto exacto de cada resultado en tu respuesta.
config.prompt: Hacé estas cuatro llamadas, en orden: 1) python_script con code = "import os\noutput = {'canary': os.environ.get('COLMENA_E2E_CANARY', 'absent')}". 2) api_explorer__list_endpoints sin argumentos. 3) sumar con a = 2 y b = 3. 4) recall_history con turn = 1.
